wiki-united-kingdom.standing: Daily reads of the English Wikipedia article on the United Kingdom, the union of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Its baseline is high, so only news that reaches readers well beyond Britain moves it.
wiki-united-kingdom.recent: The UK sanctioned Israeli settlements as entities rather than settlers, a step no G7 state had taken, and Israel shut the British consulate in Jerusalem that served Palestinians. In Portsmouth, masked crowds blocked migrant buses after 140 asylum seekers landed from Normandy, and protesters later mistook Pakistan's youth cricketers for migrants.

stocks:SHEL.standing: Shell plc's New York-listed shares. The London-based major is Europe's largest oil company and the world's biggest LNG trader, so its price tracks crude, gas prices and refining margins.

stocks:TSLA.standing: Shares of Tesla, the US electric-car maker listed on Nasdaq, whose valuation rests less on cars sold than on bets about self-driving taxis, robots and batteries. It is heavy enough to move the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100.
stocks:TSLA.recent: Tesla's Cybercab began carrying paying passengers in Austin, with no steering wheel and no regulatory approval. A day later, federal regulators opened a safety probe into 1,000 Cybercabs, and the shares dropped 6% as the launch was labelled a bust.

stocks:NVDA.standing: Nvidia designs the graphics processors that train and run most large AI models. Its share price has become the market's running bet on how much the big cloud companies will spend on AI.
stocks:NVDA.recent: Nvidia spent the fortnight paying for reach beyond its own chips: $3.5 billion in bonds for an option on a MediaTek stake, which sent MediaTek's shares up 10%, then $12.9 billion for the AI platform Hugging Face. Kalshi now wants to list round-the-clock perpetual futures on the stock, regulated by the CFTC rather than the SEC.

stocks:AAPL.standing: Shares of Apple, the Cupertino maker of the iPhone and Mac, traded on Nasdaq. It is one of the largest companies by market value, so it weighs heavily in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100, and its manufacturing runs largely through China.
stocks:AAPL.recent: The climb came as enterprise AI buyers emptied Apple's Mac inventory, and John Ternus took over from Cook as CEO. The launch event then brought the Duo, a $1,999 passport-shaped foldable, which Samsung met with a roasting spree, and left the standard iPhone 18 out of the lineup.

stocks:ERIC.standing: US-listed shares of Sweden's Ericsson, which builds the radio and core equipment mobile networks run on. With Nokia and Huawei it supplies most of the world's 5G gear, so it trades on how much operators spend.
stocks:ERIC.recent: The only related story of the fortnight was Moscow's launch of a Russian 5G network that no iPhone can join, and nothing in it accounts for the share price.

stocks:NOK.standing: Nokia's shares as traded in New York, priced in dollars. The Finnish company sells the radio, fibre and core equipment that mobile operators build their networks from, so its price follows what carriers spend on 5G.

stocks:SHOP.standing: Shares of the Ottawa-based company whose software runs online stores for millions of independent merchants. Most of its revenue is a cut of what those shops sell, so the stock trades as a read on online spending outside Amazon.
stocks:SHOP.recent: The fortnight's one Shopify story was about engineering, not earnings: the company is rewriting its apps in Swift and Kotlin, dropping React Native, the Meta framework it championed from 2020. Nothing in it touches merchant sales or revenue, and it does not explain the fall in the shares.

poly-will-marine-le-pen-win-the-2027-fre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marine Le Pen, the long-time face of France's far-right National Rally, wins the 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will stake on that outcome.
poly-will-marine-le-pen-win-the-2027-fre.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's news concerned France or Marine Le Pen. The nearest political event was the AfD's win in Saxony-Anhalt, the first far-right victory in a German state election since World War 2, followed by Merz attacking the party in parliament. None of it bears directly on this contract.

poly-will-kamala-harris-win-the-2028-us-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Kamala Harris wins the 2028 US presidential election. Years before the primaries, it trades mostly on whether she runs and can win the Democratic nomination.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-republic.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if J.D. Vance becomes the Republican presidential nominee in 2028. As the sitting vice president he is the party's presumptive heir, and the price is what traders bet that claim is worth.

stocks:BA.standing: Shares of Boeing, one of the world's two makers of large passenger jets and a major US defence contractor. The price moves on delivery rates, regulators' safety findings and the cash its jet programmes burn.
stocks:BA.recent: An Amazon 767 freighter overran the runway in Miami and killed five; the NTSB said its pilots tried to abort the landing, and the debate that followed was about runway buffers, not the jet. Boeing and Lockheed, ULA's owners, are weighing a sale of the rocket venture. Neither story accounts for the fall in the share price.

stocks:LMT.standing: Shares in the largest US defence contractor, maker of the F-35 fighter and the Trident missile. Most of its revenue comes from the US government, so the stock moves on Pentagon budgets and foreign arms sales.
stocks:LMT.recent: India signed a $45.7 million deal to buy Javelin anti-tank missiles. Lockheed expanded its sites to support its munitions production ramp. It and Boeing, which each guaranteed ULA $500 million, weighed selling the launch company. None of this explains the fall in the share price.

poly-fed-rate-hike-in-2026.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US Federal Reserve raises its benchmark interest rate at any meeting in 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on tighter money, which would lift borrowing costs worldwide.
poly-fed-rate-hike-in-2026.recent: Warsh used Jackson Hole to say the Fed would have "work to do" if inflation doesn't fade, and a payroll surge the following week strengthened that case. Oil did the rest: the shock already threatening a Fed cut deepened when Houthis captured Yemen's port of Mocha, and crude jumped again.

wiki-houthi-movement.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on the Houthis, the Zaidi movement that has held Sanaa and northern Yemen since 2014. Their coastline faces the Bab al-Mandab, the strait carrying Red Sea shipping toward Suez.
wiki-houthi-movement.recent: The Houthis seized Mokha, the historic coffee port 75 kilometers from Bab al-Mandab, after a coastal advance that killed 81 in one day. Two days earlier their strikes on Saudi energy sites around Jazan wounded 73 civilians, and Pakistan is now mediating between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if JD Vance is elected US president in 2028. It trades as a share price between zero and one hundred, and it is the cleanest running read on how much money is behind the vice-president as the Republican heir.
poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.recent: The venues these contracts trade on spent the fortnight in court: the Ninth Circuit held that Kalshi's sports bets are not "swaps" and left state gambling regulators their power, New Jersey asked the Supreme Court to settle whether federal swap rules preempt state law, and a White House aide was fined for betting on speeches he had read in advance.

xmr.standing: A cryptocurrency whose ledger hides sender, receiver and amount by default, using ring signatures and stealth addresses. That opacity makes it the settlement asset of choice for ransomware crews and darknet markets, and the reason most large exchanges have delisted it.
xmr.recent: A group calling itself VantaCore began hitting Russian companies with custom ransomware, striking at least seven firms — extortion campaigns route payment through the one major coin that resists chain analysis, and demand for it rises with them. Nothing else in the fortnight's reporting bears on the price.
